entries.title: Labour-pricing fields on ticket settings and ticket categories retired
entries.replacement: Billing profiles. Labour rates and billability come from the organization's billing profile: assign one with PUT /api/v1/orgs/organizations/:id/billing-profile, or edit rates under Settings -> Billing -> Rates. A ticket category no longer carries pricing: set its defaultWorkTypeId and price that work type on the billing profile.
entries.deprecationBehaviour: Accepted and silently ignored: the request succeeds but the value is not stored, so a caller changing a rate keeps billing at the old one.
entries.removalBehaviour: A request that includes any of these fields is rejected with HTTP 400 naming the field and its replacement. Nothing else in the request is applied.

entries.title: The /ai/provider API (one partner AI key and one default model) retired
entries.replacement: The AI model registry API. Read connections, models and per-feature defaults with GET /api/v1/ai/models. Connect an Anthropic key with POST /api/v1/ai/models/connections, rotate it with POST /api/v1/ai/models/connections/:id/key, choose or clear a catalog endpoint with POST /api/v1/ai/models/connections/:id/endpoint, and disconnect with DELETE /api/v1/ai/models/connections/:id. The single partner default model is replaced by per-feature defaults: PUT /api/v1/ai/models/assignments.
entries.deprecationBehaviour: Kept working against the AI model registry as an API-only compatibility surface; the web app stopped calling it in the same release.
entries.removalBehaviour: Every /api/v1/ai/provider request returns HTTP 404. Nothing is read or changed.
